title: Tab. VIII (figures 87-106), from Entdeckungen über die Theorie des Klanges
maker: Ernst Florens Friedrich Chladni (figures); engraved by Capieux ("Capieux sculps. 1786")
date: 1787 (Leipzig: Weidmanns Erben und Reich); plate dated 1786
source: Getty Research Institute copy, digitised by the Internet Archive
note: Leaf n106 of the 500 ppi scan, 3170 x 3961, unaltered apart from re-encoding as WebP q90. This is the finished sheet the piece ends on.

title: The same sheet before printing (derived)
license: Public domain (derivative of a public-domain scan)
note: Every ink pixel (and an 11 px halo) replaced by real paper texture copied from a clean offset nearby, colour-matched to the local paper by a normalised Gaussian estimate and feathered into the scan. Outside the ink it is the scan.

title: Ink classes and arrival times (derived, lossless)
note: Half resolution. R: time inside its stage (0-254). G: class (1-20 nodal lines of figs 87-106, 21-40 the plate squares, 41-60 numbers and letters, 61 border, 62 title and engraver's line, 0 paper).

title: Sand fields for the twenty plates (derived, lossless)
note: 5 x 4 tiles of 128 x 128 over each plate's interior. R: vibration amplitude stand-in (0 on Chladni's lines, 1 on the ridges between them and at the free edge). G: arrival time of the nearest line ink. B: the line mask at tile resolution.
